blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Tensions once again arose between protesters and police at Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila on Tuesday ahead of US President Donald Trump’s visit for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit. READ: Protesters, police clash in Manila during Asean Summit protest According to Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) secretary general Mong Palatino, the confrontation occurred after police tried to intercept one of their vehicles carrying the sound system for their demonstration. “But we managed to get the sound system inside Liwasang Bonifacio,” Palatino said. “This is what police tried to seize from the protesters,” he added, referring to […]...
